snapshot.reason: The commencement of commercial operations for Unit#5 (250 MW) at the Subansiri Lower HE Project adds immediate generation capacity and revenue.
snapshot.why_now: The commercial operation date is scheduled for October 23, 2026, providing a clear, imminent operational catalyst.
source_headlines: NHPC Limited: NHPC Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates-In compliance to Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR, intimation regarding commercial operation (CoD) of Unit#5 (250 MW) of Subansiri Lower HE Project (8x250 MW), Assam/Arunachal Pradesh from 00:00 hours 23.10.2026 is submitted. The other details given in the attached letter.
